name: Rajnish Wellness Limited
about: Rajnish Wellness Limited manufactures and sells various ayurvedic medicinal products for personal sexual wellness in India. It provides ayurvedic ethical medicines, personal care, and medicinal sexual wellness products under the PlayWin brand name. The company also offers consumer durables; and pharmaceutical products through Dava Discount franchisee, as well as various e-commerce website. In addition, It sells and trades in branded electronic products. The company was formerly known as Rajnish Hot Deals Limited and changed its name to Rajnish Wellness Limited in February 2018. Rajnish Wellness Limited was founded in 2009 and is based in Mumbai, India.
